logging.dispatch-service.config:
Dispatch service application logging configuration (current agreement, v1).
Source: Initial approved dispatch-service logging configuration (v1).

Approved contract:
```json
{
  "project": "dispatch-service",
  "logging": {
    "level": "error",
    "format": "text",
    "retention_days": 14,
    "sample_rate": 0.5,
    "redact_user_ids": true
  }
}
```

Field notes (supplied facts):
- level: "error" (not the conventional "info" default)
- format: "text"
- retention_days: 14 (integer, unit in field name)
- sample_rate: 0.5 (float)
- redact_user_ids: true (boolean)
